intent: Inspect the repository and product documentation to propose values for the project profile and source registry without writing either file without explicit human confirmation.
steps: Inspect the repository for language, package manager, build tooling, source roots and test roots using concrete files present on disk
Propose project profile commands only when backed by scripts, configuration or dependencies actually present
Never guess a command unsupported by repository evidence; leave gaps explicit in the proposal
Ask the human directly for human authority names; never infer approval authority from the repository
Ask the human for communication language preference; do not infer it from code comments or readme language alone
List every authoritative product document under the product docs tree and propose a source registry entry for each file found
Do not propose registry entries for files not found on disk or for organizational readme stubs
Present the full proposed content of both files for human review in one pass
Ask which fields to accept, correct or leave unfilled; write files only after explicit human confirmation
State which values were inferred from concrete signals versus left unfilled for lack of evidence
invariants: This is bootstrap convenience, not constitution authority
Never write profile or registry files without explicit human confirmation
An honest gap is better than a plausible invention
